deviations.root-help: cfy has a native Rust command tree and therefore differs in usage/topic text while preserving the help contract.
deviations.invalid-command: cfy uses exit code 2 for structured CLI parse errors; Shopify CLI 4.6.1 uses exit code 1 for this scenario.
deviations.theme-help: cfy exposes the implemented native theme surface and explicit backend adapters; the topic help is intentionally not text-identical.
deviations.app-help: cfy exposes the native app pipeline and adapter-backed commands; the topic help is intentionally not text-identical.
deviations.version-json: cfy reports its own Rust release metadata instead of the Shopify Node runtime string.
deviations.config-help: cfy exposes native config/cache/autoupgrade commands; Shopify exposes a different config topic tree.
deviations.theme-check-missing: cfy delegates Theme Check through an adapter and reports adapter remediation.
deviations.app-info-outside-project: cfy uses native project discovery and typed diagnostics; Shopify uses its Node project error format.
deviations.app-build-outside-project: cfy native build pipeline diagnostics differ from Shopify's JS toolchain diagnostics.
deviations.deploy-dry-run: cfy deploy backend is fixture/adapter based until live Admin API credentials are configured.
